title: Voices of Freelance Professional Writers on AI: Limitations, Expectations, and Fears

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying multilingual freelance writers to rate and compare AI chatbot performance, grammatical correctness, and idiomatic accuracy in non-English languages versus English, supplemented by text similarity metrics to quantify required human edits on non-English AI outputs.

Using a questionnaire to ask participants to self-report how adequately their culture is represented in AI chatbot outputs, combined with an interactive task where users generate local event advertisements and explicitly flag and edit cultural inaccuracies or lack of nuances.
